items.problem: CS0103 'Colors' does not exist in the current context (LogView.xaml.cs:112) — and the same class of failure for any unqualified member of the non-Xaml Windows.UI.* sibling namespaces (Colors, ColorHelper in Windows.UI; FontWeights, FontStyle in Windows.UI.Text).
items.evidence: migration-score.json candidate_build_errors[0]; source uses 'new SolidColorBrush(Colors.Red)' (session-log.txt L3095/L8105) and 'Windows.UI.Colors.Green' (L2527).
items.skill_search: grepped MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md for 'Colors', 'CS0103', 'Windows.UI' and SKILL.md; grepped Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1 for the rewrite scope.
items.root_cause: The bootstrap mass-rewrite only maps the Windows.UI.Xaml.* family (Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1 line 113: $orig -replace 'Windows\.UI\.Xaml','Microsoft.UI.Xaml'). The sibling non-Xaml Windows.UI.* namespaces are not remapped, so simple-name references such as Colors.Red are left without a valid using and fail as CS0103. The 'Common build errors' section of MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md — the place an agent fixing a build looks — has entries for CS0104, CS0227 and CS0246 but NONE for CS0103. The Namespace Mapping table does list 'Windows.UI.Colors -> Microsoft.UI.Colors' but only as a passive reference row, not as a build-error remedy, and it omits the critical per-type caveat.
items.proposed_fix: Add a 'CS0103: <name> does not exist after the namespace rewrite' entry to the 'Common build errors' section of MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md, stating that the bootstrap only rewrites the Windows.UI.Xaml.* family and that the sibling non-Xaml Windows.UI.* namespaces must be remapped by hand: Windows.UI -> Microsoft.UI for Colors/ColorHelper, Windows.UI.Text -> Microsoft.UI.Text for FontWeights/FontStyle. Call out the per-type split caveat: the Color struct stays Windows.UI.Color while only the Colors/ColorHelper static classes move to Microsoft.UI.
items.generalizes: Colors, ColorHelper and FontWeights appear in a large fraction of UWP XAML samples (any brush/foreground/font styling in code-behind). Because the bootstrap deterministically rewrites only the Xaml family, this exact CS0103 recurs on essentially every UWP->WinUI3 migration that styles colors or fonts from code — it is not specific to AdaptiveStreaming.
